from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A single financial line item extracted from a document."""
    item_name: str = Field(description="The exact line-item name as written in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount as a number")
    period: Literal["期初", "期末", "其他"] = Field(description="Whether this is beginning period, ending period, or other period descriptor")
    currency: str = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency unit of the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_name: list[str] = Field(description="Company name as written in this document")
    stock_code: list[str] = Field(description="Stock/securities code if available in this document")
    period: list[str] = Field(description="Reporting period/date covered by this document")
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem] = Field(description="All financial line items found in this document")
